resources.string: Your journal is encrypted on this device and unlocks with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
Set up a screen lock on this device first. Terpoir uses it to protect your journal.
The device\'s secure key storage did not respond. Try again.
Your fingerprints or face changed, so this device\'s key no longer works. Unlock with your recovery key.
Blocks screenshots, screen recording and casting of Terpoir, and hides it in your recent apps. Screen readers and other accessibility tools keep working.
When off, screenshots and recordings of Terpoir are saved to your photo gallery, and from there to any cloud backup it syncs with.
When off, anyone you cast or share your screen with sees your journal, and so does any app allowed to capture your screen.
Turn it back on here. Screenshots already taken stay in your gallery until you delete them.
Are you of legal age to use cannabis where you live?
Google Play may tell Terpoir an age range for your account. Terpoir only checks it on this phone, to keep out under-18s, and never stores or sends it.
Come back when you\'re of legal age where you live.
This key is the only way back into your journal if you lose or reset this phone. There\'s no reset link and no backdoor, and nobody, not even us, can recover your journal without it.
Write it down and keep the paper somewhere safe, or keep it in a password manager. Not next to wherever you sync your journal: a key kept with the data it locks is no protection.
Your password manager, and its sync, become part of what protects your journal. Terpoir clears the clipboard after a minute.
We will never ask for your recovery key.
Without your recovery key, losing, resetting or replacing this phone means losing your journal for good. This key won\'t be shown again.
Type your recovery key from your saved copy. Capitals and dashes don\'t matter.
That\'s not the whole key yet: it has 56 characters.
There\'s a character that never appears in a recovery key.
That doesn\'t match. Check your copy for a typo.
That\'s a recovery key, but not this journal\'s.
This is your Privacy Center. Everything starts at its most private, and nothing changes unless you change it, here, whenever you like.
